title: Episode About the Brass Near Jaal Piloo Forest

blocks.text: The roaming camp in the scrub country depends on uncertain villagers, and many people first take payment and only afterward decide whether they will give anything back. (13–15)
One day thirst presses hard, and a local Khan refuses even water until coins are produced, exposing again how survival now hangs on water and provisions rather than on settled security. (16–18)
Majha Sikhs begin arriving as word spreads, and milk, curds, and small provisions start to flow again toward the Guru from those who still come out of love rather than fear. (19–21)
